    OpenCode AI is a fully open‑source AI coding agent that helps you write and run code in the terminal, desktop app, or IDE, supporting 75+ AI models including GPT, Claude, and Gemini. It is free to use, privacy‑first, and integrates with GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Plus/Pro, and local models.

    What OpenCode AI Is

    OpenCode is an open‑source, local‑first AI coding agent designed to act as an autonomous pair programmer. It works across:

    • Terminal interface
    • Desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux)
    • IDE extensions (VS Code, Cursor, Zed, Windsurf, VSCodium)
      opencode.ai

    Key Features

    • Supports any model: GPT‑5, Claude 4.5, Gemini 4, and 75+ providers via Models.dev.
    • Local‑first privacy: Does not store your code or context data.
    • Multi‑session agents: Run multiple autonomous agents in parallel.
    • LSP‑intelligent suggestions: Type‑safe, definition‑aware completions.
    • Bring Your Own Keys (BYOK): Use your existing AI subscriptions.
      open-code.dev

    Installation

    You can install OpenCode using curl, npm, bun, or Homebrew:

    Code
    curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/v2/install | bash

    Or download desktop versions for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
    opencode.ai

    Cost

    OpenCode is 100% free. You only pay for external AI model providers if you choose to connect them.
    opencode.ai

    Open Source

    The entire project is MIT‑licensed and available on GitHub with over 220k stars and thousands of contributors.
    GitHub

    OpenCode AI is a robust, privacy‑first, open‑source alternative to tools like GitHub Copilot, offering broad model support and deep integration across development environments.
